text: The dome show was beyond anything our students expected. They were completely engaged and talked about it for weeks!
Booked a birthday astronomy party for my son. The astronomy educators were fantastic and made it truly magical.
A perfect blend of curriculum-aligned content and hands-on excitement. Our science fair was a huge hit because of them.
Professional, organized and inspiring. The telescope night under the stars was unforgettable for our whole school.
Our community event drew record crowds. The pop-up observatory and dome shows were simply spectacular.
The STEM workshops are hands-on, well-structured and deeply tied to the curriculum. Highly recommended.
